faq.q1: How do we share a truck if our farms are in different places?
faq.a1: The truck arrives at your village cluster. Bags are weighed, tagged, and recorded on the spot at village pickup before loading together. You only pay for your own lot's proportional freight.
faq.q2: What if internet or mobile network is weak in the village?
faq.a2: Works smoothly on low-bandwidth 2G mobile data with offline caching. Mandi benchmarks and pooling manifests cache locally and sync immediately upon reconnection.
faq.q3: When and how do I get my money?
faq.a3: Your payment is guaranteed. The buyer deposits the money before the truck leaves. As soon as quality is checked at the gate, cash is sent straight to your bank account within 4 hours.
faq.q4: Are these prices real or just estimates?
faq.a4: Every price comes directly from official government Mandi registers and real mill contracts updated daily. No guesswork, no false promises.
